LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtDesignLocked: The lotus pond design has not been acquired.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtQingheArrivedLetterText: The water in the lotus pond has stilled. Qinghe has followed this new court to the colony and is willing to stay. She still needs a decent Lotus Rain Pavilion before she can truly settle in.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtSecondStageLetterText: The lotus pond has been built. Arrange its room into a decent Lotus Rain Pavilion. When it is ready, you will receive a copy of "Lotus Rain Pavilion Artistry".
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtCompletedLetterText: The Lotus Rain Pavilion has settled into place. In response, a copy of "Lotus Rain Pavilion Artistry" has appeared beside the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtAutoAcceptedLetterText: Qinghe has prepared the lotus pond design. You can now build a lotus pond from the Misc category and use it as the core of the new Flower Court.
